# Spicy Lyrics renderer

This directory contains code copied and adapted from
[Spicy Lyrics](https://github.com/spikerko/spicy-lyrics/) at commit
`cc45160facbebbe6c872a8796d339c0602d58928`.

The upstream project is copyright its contributors and distributed under the
GNU Affero General Public License v3.0. The included `LICENSE` applies to the
files in this directory.

Monochrome replaces the Spicetify-specific player and data adapters, while
retaining the Spicy Lyrics renderer's DOM model, CSS, line states, word/letter
animation curves, spring constants and centered scrolling behavior.
